latestCommitMessage:
fix(ime): preserve candidate text buffer conversions

Mark custom text measurements dirty before forwarding setText to TextView.
Preserve same-content buffer changes used by accessibility traversal and let
the framework normalize null. Remove redundant layout forwarding while
retaining TextView measurement to keep its Layout synchronized.
actionsTaken: Dirty custom measurement caches before framework setText.
Forward nullable CharSequence directly to TextView.
Retain unconditional superclass setText for equal-content BufferType transitions.
Remove superclass onLayout forwarding introduced by the previous patch.
Retain superclass onMeasure to update TextView Layout; Android control still pending.
